metadata.title: Family Group: The Will
metadata.subtitle: Ten minutes after Grandmother's funeral, someone unsent a shocking message in the family chat.

nodes.text: 4:10 PM · Ten minutes after Grandmother's funeral. The family group chat 'Monte Verde Estate' suddenly lights up.
Everyone, please dry your tears. The notary reads Mother's will at 6 PM sharp. Let's honor her wishes in peace.
Did the notary burn page two yet? If {{player_name}} sees it we get NOTHING.
Wait... I read that before you deleted it, Lucas! What second page?!
Relax, {{player_name}}! Wrong chat—I was texting my accountant about a car lease lol.
How dare you start drama on the day we bury your grandmother, {{player_name}}! Show some respect!

nodes.transcript: Forgive the interruption. Before 6 PM, {{player_name}} must hear a private recording your grandmother left with me last Tuesday.

nodes.prompt: The family chat goes dead silent. What do you do?

options.label: Call out Aunt & Cousin in the group
options.player_reply_text: I screenshotted what you unsent, Lucas. Explain it now!

options.label: Play Grandmother's secret voice note
options.player_reply_text: Send me Grandmother's recording right now, Ricardo.

nodes.text: You ungrateful child! Lucas only helped Mother settle her estate taxes!
Drop it, {{player_name}}. You weren't even here for the last two years.

nodes.transcript: SECRET UNLOCKED — Grandmother's voice: '{{player_name}}, my darling. Do not trust Beatriz. My real will is hidden inside the blue porcelain vase in my study.'

nodes.text: The blue porcelain vase... Grandma knew they would try to switch the will!
SYSTEM ALERT: Aunt Beatriz just removed Attorney Ricardo from the family group—and locked the mansion's upstairs hallway.

nodes.headline: Why Did She Kick Out The Lawyer?
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 2: Fifteen minutes until the reading of the will. Reach Grandmother's study before they destroy the truth.

nodes.text: 5:45 PM · Fifteen minutes before the will reading. You slip into Grandmother's silent study through the garden balcony.
Where did you disappear to, {{player_name}}? Everyone is seated in the dining hall.
Check the upstairs study! If {{player_name}} opens the blue vase we're finished!
Too late, Aunt Beatriz. I'm already holding the blue vase—and the red wax envelope inside.

nodes.transcript: Listen to me, {{player_name}}! Do not open that! Lucas and I kept this vineyard alive—half of this estate belongs to us!

nodes.text: Private DM · I am at the front gate with two court witnesses, {{player_name}}. Do you have the sealed envelope?

nodes.prompt: Heavy footsteps race up the grand staircase! Make your move!

options.label: Post the real will in the family chat
options.player_reply_text: Everyone in the dining hall: check your phones right now.

options.label: Open the second secret envelope too
options.player_reply_text: Wait—there's a second envelope taped under the vase!

nodes.text: You snap a clear photo of the notarized will and drop it in the family chat: 100% of Monte Verde Estate goes to {{player_name}}.
NO! That's a fake! She promised me the vineyard!
SECRET UNLOCKED: Inside the second envelope is a bank audit proving Lucas forged Grandmother's signature on a $2M loan—plus a private family secret!
Not only is the estate mine, Lucas—Grandma left proof of your $2M forgery. The police are walking in with Ricardo.

nodes.transcript: {{player_name}}, there is one final clause on page three. You have a half-brother no one in this house knew about... and he just stepped through the front gate.

nodes.headline: The Secret Heir Has Arrived...
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 3: Attorney Ricardo opens the sealed DNA envelope—and Aunt Beatriz turns pale.

nodes.text: 6:15 PM · Family Group Chat. The iron gates creak open as a black sedan pulls up to the mansion.
Security, throw that impostor off the lawn! My mother never had another grandson!

nodes.caption: Certified Lab Report: 99.97% Grandchild Match — verified by Grandmother two weeks before passing.

nodes.text: Wait... Grandmother already ran the DNA test?! Aunt Beatriz, why did you hide this?!
Victor, hold my offshore loan till morning—if this half-brother splits the villa, I default at dawn! WAIT—wrong chat!
Hold on! Aunt Beatriz, you used the family villa as collateral without telling us?!

nodes.transcript: [clearing throat] Everyone, please come to the library. There is a second sealed document inside the blue porcelain vase.

nodes.text: Touch that vase, {{player_name}}, and I will contest the entire will for ten years!

nodes.prompt: The family chat is split in two. What is your next move?

options.label: Invite the half-brother into the library
options.player_reply_text: Open the gates. If Grandmother verified his bloodline, he belongs in that room.

options.label: Pull the villa mortgage registry first
options.player_reply_text: I just pulled the public lien—Aunt Beatriz forged Grandmother's signature on a $4M loan!

nodes.text: Wise choice, {{player_name}}. Grandmother specifically wrote that kindness would be tested first.
VIP TWIST: The mortgage registry proves Aunt Beatriz committed estate fraud—disqualifying her claim under Clause 4!
Wait—check the estate charity account! Someone just wired $800,000 out ten minutes ago!
Lucas, don't look at me—your login was the one used to approve it!

nodes.headline: The Offshore Vault...
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 4: Missing charity funds spark a war inside the family chat—who is framing whom?

nodes.text: 6:40 PM · The oak library. Rain taps the stained glass while bank alerts light up every phone.
I swear on Grandmother's grave I didn't touch the charity fund! Someone cloned my banking token!

nodes.caption: Estate Wire Alert: $800,000 routed to Shell Corp "Veridian" — approved from Mansion Wi-Fi.

nodes.text: Mansion Wi-Fi? That means the thief is sitting in this room right now.
{{player_name}} DM only: Aunt Beatriz borrowed my iPad at the funeral to "print seating charts"—CRAP, wrong group!
Lucas! How dare you accuse your own aunt in front of an outsider and a lawyer!

nodes.transcript: [calmly] Actually, Madam Beatriz, the bank automatically records a FaceID snapshot on transfers over $500,000.

nodes.text: You're bluffing, Ricardo! Banks don't release that without a court order!

nodes.prompt: Aunt Beatriz reaches for the porcelain vase. How do you stop her?

options.label: Demand Attorney Ricardo freeze all accounts
options.player_reply_text: Attorney Ricardo, lock the estate accounts right now before another cent moves.

options.label: Expose her forged codicil to the whole chat
options.player_reply_text: Look at the witness stamp on your "new will," Beatriz—the notary died in 2021!

nodes.text: Already frozen, {{player_name}}. Not a single dollar leaves the trust tonight.
VIP TWIST: The family chat explodes as cousins verify the dead notary—Beatriz's forged will collapses on the spot!
{{player_name}}, I'm with you 100%. Let's open the real codicil at midnight.
Fine. Wait until midnight—then see what Grandmother REALLY left you.

nodes.headline: The Midnight Reading...
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 5: Inside Grandmother's locked study, the forged contract and the true heir's secret collide.

nodes.text: 11:55 PM · Grandmother's private study. The grandfather clock ticks toward midnight.
At midnight, the time-locked vault opens. Inside is Grandmother's final testament.

nodes.caption: Side-by-Side Audit: Beatriz's 2026 Codicil vs. Grandmother's Authentic 2025 Seal.

nodes.text: The seal on Beatriz's page is upside down—she really forged Grandmother's final wishes!
I spent twenty years managing her dinners while you visited twice a year!
You weren't managing her dinners, Auntie—you were billing the estate $30,000 a month in fake invoices!

nodes.transcript: [Grandmother's recorded voice] "My dearest {{player_name}}, if Beatriz tries to steal the blue vase, play this tape. You and your brother are my sole heirs."

nodes.text: No... She recorded a video?! Ricardo, turn that off right now!

nodes.prompt: The clock strikes 12:00 AM. How do you handle Aunt Beatriz?

options.label: Give her 24 hours to return the $800K
options.player_reply_text: Return every cent by noon tomorrow, or Ricardo hands the file to the prosecutor.

options.label: Invoke Grandmother's Iron Clause immediately
options.player_reply_text: Iron Clause activated: anyone who contests fraudulently forfeits 100% of their share.

nodes.text: You wouldn't dare send your own aunt to prison...
VIP TWIST: Ricardo stamps the Iron Clause—Beatriz's stipend, mansion key, and board seat vanish instantly!
Grandmother planned every single move from beyond the grave. Legend.
One final envelope remains, {{player_name}}—addressed only to you.

nodes.headline: The Mansion Keys
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 6 (Season Finale): The last envelope holds the keys to the estate—and your family's future.

nodes.text: 12:15 AM · The front steps of the mansion. Security escorts Aunt Beatriz's luggage to her car.
The $800,000 transfer has been reversed in full. The estate is officially yours to direct, {{player_name}}.
For what it's worth... I'm sorry I doubted you in the group chat earlier. You handled that like a boss.
We're family, Lucas. Grandmother wanted this house to bring us together, not tear us apart.
I will never forgive any of you for taking my home.
Your half-brother is waiting in the conservatory with the blue porcelain vase. He says it belongs with you.

nodes.transcript: [warmly] Grandmother wrote one last note: "Keep the doors open for love, and locked against greed."

nodes.text: So, new head of the family—what's your first official decree?

nodes.prompt: The mansion keys rest in your palm. Choose your Season Finale!

options.label: Share the estate fairly with Lucas & brother
options.player_reply_text: We rebuild together—equal shares for the honest ones, zero for the thieves.

options.label: Turn the estate into Grandmother's Foundation
options.player_reply_text: I'm keeping 100% control and turning the trust into Grandmother's scholarship fund!

nodes.text: Count me in! Let's make Grandmother proud.
VIP FINALE: The foundation charter launches with $20M—honoring Grandmother forever while Beatriz watches from outside the gate!
A brilliant ending, {{player_name}}. Grandmother chose the right heir.
Welcome home, everyone. The family chat finally has peace.

nodes.headline: Act 2: The Dawn Codicil...
nodes.teaser_text: You claimed the mansion keys—yet minutes later, a secret notarized codicil freezes the entire estate at dawn. Episode 7 begins Act 2.

nodes.text: 12:40 AM · Monte Verde Conservatory. The iron gate barely shuts behind Aunt Beatriz before Attorney Ricardo’s urgent alert hits the group.

nodes.caption: Emergency filing from the central registry: a second notarized codicil just surfaced—freezing the entire estate at dawn!

nodes.text: Did you really think I left empty-handed, {{player_name}}? Grandmother signed that codicil two days before she passed—naming MY trust sole executor!
Wait a second—two days before she passed, Grandmother could barely lift a teacup! How could she sign a four-page codicil?!
The notary clerk swore nobody would check the wax crest until after the freeze...
I just saw what you unsent, Aunt. The wax crest on that codicil is fake—and Grandmother left us a clue inside the blue porcelain vase.

nodes.prompt: The estate freeze triggers at 9 AM. What is your first move?

options.label: Ask Ricardo to pull the notary clerk’s name
options.player_reply_text: Ricardo, pull the registry stamp log—find out which clerk backdated that filing!

options.label: Inspect the velvet base of the blue vase now
options.player_reply_text: Lucas, help me flip the blue porcelain vase—Grandmother always hid keys under the velvet!

nodes.text: Got his name—a junior clerk who suddenly paid off his mortgage yesterday afternoon. I’m flagging his audit file now.
VIP TWIST: Beneath the stitched velvet base sits a tarnished brass vault key and a folded clinic slip dated 28 years ago!
Wait... why does that brass key have the exact bank vault number of Grandmother’s downtown private box?
Because whatever is inside that box—and on that 28-year-old clinic receipt—is what Beatriz has been terrified of all night.

nodes.headline: Inside The Porcelain Vase
nodes.teaser_text: Next Episode: The hidden brass key and a 28-year-old clinic receipt reveal a secret Grandmother guarded with her life.

nodes.text: 1:25 AM · Grandmother’s Oak Library. Rain taps the stained glass as you unfold the yellowed clinic slip under the desk lamp.
Look at the witness line on this 1998 clinic slip... Aunt Beatriz signed off on switching my half-brother’s birth registry!
No wonder she’s been screaming that he’s an impostor! She tried to erase him from the family tree before we were even born!

nodes.transcript: [urgently] Guard that brass key with your life, {{player_name}}. Grandmother told me her authentic wax-seal signet ring is locked inside Vault 404.

nodes.text: Still playing treasure hunt in my house? By 9 AM, the court order locks those front gates—and you’ll be sleeping in a motel.
Relax, Aunt. We’re already booked for the certified DNA re-test AND the bank vault opening at 9 AM sharp.

nodes.prompt: Aunt Beatriz suddenly goes dead quiet. What precaution do you take tonight?

options.label: Lock the brass key in Ricardo’s courier safe
options.player_reply_text: Ricardo, send your bonded courier to secure the brass key until the bank opens!

options.label: Scan the 1998 clinic slip to the family chat
options.player_reply_text: Why wait for morning? Let every aunt and uncle see your 1998 clinic signature right now!

nodes.text: Smart move. Sealed and logged—nobody can steal it before 9 AM.
VIP TWIST: Twelve relatives immediately react in shock—and Beatriz’s phone starts dialing you nonstop from an unlisted line!
Whoa—she’s losing it! Watch out, {{player_name}}, my phone just pinged that she’s calling you from an unlisted number.
Let her call. Let’s hear what she’s willing to offer in the dark.

nodes.headline: The Midnight Ultimatum
nodes.teaser_text: Next Episode: Aunt Beatriz calls from an unlisted line with a chilling threat—and Cousin Lucas hides a secret of his own.

nodes.text: 2:05 AM · Upstairs Hallway. Thunder rolls over the estate garden as an unlisted number flashes across your phone.
Sign over the holding company by noon, {{player_name}}, and I’ll let you keep the house. Fight me, and I’ll tie the estate up in court for ten years!
Funny how you only offer deals after we found the 1998 clinic slip. You’re terrified of tomorrow’s DNA lab.
She offered me 20% last month just to hand over Grandmother’s old fountain pen...
Wait—Lucas, stop everything! Did you just say Aunt Beatriz took Grandmother’s personal fountain pen last month?!

nodes.prompt: Cousin Lucas just accidentally revealed how the ink matched. How do you respond?

options.label: Tell Lucas to stay calm and save his texts
options.player_reply_text: Lucas, don’t delete a single message from her—that fountain pen proves ink forgery!

options.label: Order an ink-age forensic test at dawn
options.player_reply_text: Ricardo, book a chemical ink-age test—fresh ink dries differently from two-year-old strokes!

nodes.text: I swear I never knew she’d forge a codicil! I thought she just wanted a keepsake... I’ll back up every text tonight.
VIP TWIST: Ricardo confirms the forensic chemist will attend the 9 AM notary inspection—trapping Beatriz’s forgery in real time!
Enjoy your little theories. At 9:15 AM, the accredited DNA lab opens—and we’ll see who really belongs in this family.
Be at the notary office by 9 AM sharp, {{player_name}}. Bring the brass key.

nodes.headline: The Bloodline Test
nodes.teaser_text: Next Episode: Morning at the notary office—the certified DNA report shatters Aunt Beatriz’s claim once and for all.

nodes.text: 9:15 AM · Sunlit Notary Conference Room. Morning light spills across the glass table as Attorney Ricardo breaks the lab seal.

nodes.caption: Accredited DNA Match: 99.98% biological sibling match—AND the lab flagged that Beatriz’s earlier private swab was swapped!

nodes.text: Boom! 99.98%! Aunt Beatriz, you literally paid someone to swap the first test tube!
Bloodline doesn’t override the Dawn Codicil! Until a judge voids that notarized seal, MY trust still controls the estate accounts.
Then you’ll love our next stop at 11:30 AM—opening Grandmother’s downtown safe-deposit Vault 404.
The bank manager confirmed Vault 404 has remained sealed since 2022. Nobody—not even Beatriz—ever touched what’s inside.

nodes.prompt: Aunt Beatriz storms out toward the elevator. What do you do?

options.label: Head straight to the bank with Ricardo & Lucas
options.player_reply_text: Let her fume—let’s get to Vault 404 before she tries any new legal stunt!

options.label: Request bank CCTV of anyone asking for Box 404
options.player_reply_text: Ricardo, ask the bank manager if Beatriz ever tried to break into Vault 404!

nodes.text: Car’s already waiting out front. Let’s go see what Grandmother left in Vault 404.
VIP TWIST: The manager logs show Beatriz arrived THREE DAYS AGO with a locksmith’s order—and was turned away!
That proves she knew Vault 404 holds the exact object that destroys her Dawn Codicil.
Then let’s unlock it right now.

nodes.headline: The Hidden Ring
nodes.teaser_text: Next Episode: Inside Vault 404 rests Grandmother’s engraved signet ring—exposing the counterfeit seal on the codicil.

nodes.text: 11:30 AM · Downtown Bank Vault Room. Fluorescent light shines on the steel drawer as the brass key clicks smoothly.

nodes.caption: Look at the engraved crest on Grandmother’s signet ring—three olive leaves, NOT two! The wax seal on Aunt’s codicil is a fake!

nodes.text: Incredible! Grandmother purposely altered the third leaf in 2022 as an anti-forgery mark—and only told the bank vault registrar!
{{player_name}}, Ricardo... I need to tell you both the full truth before we leave this room. I’m done hiding.

nodes.transcript: [quietly] Last month Aunt Beatriz paid off my business loan—then pressured me into giving her Grandmother’s old fountain pen. I didn’t know she’d forge the codicil.

nodes.text: Lucas, don’t you dare open your mouth! Remember who saved your startup from bankruptcy!

nodes.prompt: Cousin Lucas is torn between guilt and fear. What do you tell him?

options.label: Forgive him if he testifies at the tribunal
options.player_reply_text: Stand with us at the family tribunal, Lucas—and we’ll wipe the slate clean.

options.label: Ask for his phone logs first to trace the clerk
options.player_reply_text: Prove it right now, Lucas—show Ricardo the text where Beatriz bragged about the notary clerk!

nodes.text: I’m in, {{player_name}}. Aunt Beatriz can keep her threats—I’m handing over every message she sent me.
VIP TWIST: Lucas unlocks his chat history—revealing the exact bank wire date Beatriz used to bribe the notary clerk!
With the signet ring AND Lucas’s texts, we’re one bank transfer away from criminal fraud charges.
Let’s grab lunch and pull that transfer record—I owe Grandmother this much.

nodes.headline: Cousin’s Confession
nodes.teaser_text: Next Episode: Lucas steps forward in the family chat—turning Aunt Beatriz’s closest pawn into your star witness.

nodes.text: 1:50 PM · Monte Verde Terrace. Afternoon sun warms the stone balustrade as Lucas posts his full confession in the family group.
Everyone—I’m putting this on record. Last month Aunt Beatriz tricked me into handing over Grandmother’s fountain pen so she could fake the Dawn Codicil.
You ungrateful brat! You’re lying because {{player_name}} promised you a bigger slice of the mansion!
No promises needed, Aunt. He just gave Ricardo the exact date and branch where you wired the bribe to the notary clerk.
And the registry’s internal compliance officer just pulled the wire confirmation. Uploading it to our legal dossier at 4 PM.
Honestly? Best weight lifted off my chest in a month. Whatever happens tomorrow, I’m standing beside you, {{player_name}}.

nodes.prompt: The elders in the family chat are asking for a formal meeting. When do you call it?

options.label: Call a full Family Tribunal at 9 AM tomorrow
options.player_reply_text: Tomorrow, 9 AM sharp in the Monte Verde dining hall—every heir, every elder, and the notary board!

options.label: Invite the economic fraud unit to observe too
options.player_reply_text: Invite the fraud investigators to sit in the back row—no more family cover-ups!

nodes.text: Notices sent. The senior notary chief already accepted—he wants to see the signet ring with his own eyes.
VIP TWIST: Two fraud detectives confirm attendance—turning tomorrow’s breakfast table into a full courtroom!
Oh, I’ll be at the gate tomorrow morning alright—with a court appraiser to auction off every painting in that house!
Wait for 4 PM, {{player_name}}. The clerk’s payoff receipt just cleared compliance—I’m sending it now.

nodes.headline: The Silent Payoff
nodes.teaser_text: Next Episode: A completed wire receipt links Aunt Beatriz directly to the corrupt clerk who backdated the will.

nodes.text: 4:10 PM · Attorney Ricardo’s Law Office. Golden afternoon light slants across the conference desk as the bank confirmation prints.

nodes.caption: TRANSFER COMPLETED: $120,000 wired from Beatriz’s personal savings directly to the notary clerk’s brother—40 minutes before the Dawn Codicil was stamped!

nodes.text: Forty minutes before the stamp! She didn’t even bother hiding the transfer behind an offshore shell this time!
That’s game over, right? We have the signet ring, the DNA report, my texts, AND the bribe wire!
Not until the notary board meets at 9 AM. Keep your guard up—Beatriz is desperate, and desperate people swing wildly.
Fine—if I can’t have Monte Verde, I’ll freeze every utility and auction the art gallery first...

nodes.prompt: Aunt Beatriz just tipped off her next stunt. How do you prepare?

options.label: Lock the art gallery and alert estate security
options.player_reply_text: Double the guards on the gallery wing—nobody touches a single frame of Grandmother’s paintings!

options.label: Have Ricardo file a counter-injunction right now
options.player_reply_text: File the bribe wire with the duty judge today—block any auction order before sunset!

nodes.text: Done! Head of security changed all gallery keycodes and locked the iron driveway gate.
VIP TWIST: The duty judge stamps an emergency hold—forbidding Beatriz from removing a single asset from Monte Verde!
Head back to the mansion before the evening storm hits, {{player_name}}. Keep your phone charged.
Uh oh... my estate banking app just sent a red alert. Beatriz’s emergency freeze just hit the operating account!

nodes.headline: The Estate Freeze
nodes.teaser_text: Next Episode: Mid-Season Twist—storm clouds break as Ricardo calls with urgent news about Beatriz’s dawn raid.

nodes.text: 8:45 PM · Monte Verde Study. Lightning forks over the cypress trees as Attorney Ricardo’s urgent call rattles the desk.
{{player_name}}, stay calm! Beatriz used a rural magistrate to slap a 24-hour freeze on the estate’s payroll—and she’s bringing private auctioneers at 8:30 AM!
8:30 AM? That’s thirty minutes BEFORE our Family Tribunal starts! She wants to humiliate us in front of the staff before the notary board arrives!
Wait—what if we move the Family Tribunal up to 8:15 AM without telling her?!

nodes.transcript: [laughing coldly] Hope you packed your bags, {{player_name}}. Tomorrow at 8:30 AM, every heirloom in Monte Verde goes under my hammer.

nodes.prompt: Cousin Lucas’s ambush idea is brilliant. How do you spring it?

options.label: Seat the entire tribunal at 8:15 AM silently
options.player_reply_text: Yes! Seat the elders, the notary chief, and the forensic chemist by 8:15 AM—then open the gate with a smile!

options.label: Bring the bribed clerk’s summons to the table
options.player_reply_text: And Ricardo—have the fraud unit summon that notary clerk at 8:30 AM so he cracks mid-tribunal!

nodes.text: Grandmother would be applauding right now. Every member just confirmed 8:15 AM sharp.
VIP TWIST: The fraud investigator confirms the clerk’s summons is set for 8:30 AM—leaving Beatriz zero escape routes!
Your half-brother is already polishing the dining table and setting out the blue porcelain vase in the center.
One last night under the storm. Tomorrow morning, the Family Tribunal settles this forever.

nodes.headline: Act 3: The Night Before The Tribunal
nodes.teaser_text: Next Episode: Act 3 begins—all four pieces of proof align inside the oak library before the dawn reckoning.

nodes.text: 10:55 PM · Monte Verde Oak Library. Rain streaks the tall windows as four sealed folders rest beside Grandmother’s signet ring.
Final checklist, {{player_name}}: DNA match, three-leaf signet ring, Lucas’s fountain-pen logs, and the $120,000 clerk wire.
Hey... thanks for not kicking me out of this room after I messed up with the fountain pen. I won’t blink tomorrow.
You told the truth when it mattered most, Lucas. That’s what separates you from Aunt Beatriz.
Just a friendly reminder: the auction trucks arrive at 8:30 AM sharp. Better clear your personal junk out of the conservatory.
She truly has no idea the elders and the notary chief will already be sipping coffee inside at 8:15 AM.

nodes.prompt: One last message to Aunt Beatriz before midnight. What do you send?

options.label: Tell her the front gate will be wide open
options.player_reply_text: No need to knock at 8:30 AM, Aunt—the front gate and dining hall will be wide open for you.

options.label: Remind her to bring her magnifying glass
options.player_reply_text: Bring your glasses tomorrow, Aunt—you’ll want a close look at Grandmother’s third olive leaf.

nodes.text: Glad you finally learned your place. See you at 8:30.
VIP TWIST: Beatriz reads your message immediately—then leaves the chat on "Seen" without a single word of reply!
Get some rest, {{player_name}}. Tomorrow morning, Monte Verde gets its honor back.
See you at 8:15 AM sharp.

nodes.headline: The Gate Standoff
nodes.teaser_text: Next Episode: Morning arrives—Aunt Beatriz marches through the iron gate straight into a packed Family Tribunal.

nodes.text: 8:30 AM · Sunlit Monte Verde Driveway. Birds chirp in the cypress trees as Beatriz’s black sedan sweeps through the open gate.
My appraiser is right behind me. Hand over the keys to the gallery wing right now, {{player_name}}.
Come right into the dining hall, Aunt. Someone else wants to inspect your Dawn Codicil before any appraiser touches a painting.
THE DOORS SWING OPEN: Seated around the long oak table are six family elders, the Senior Notary Chief, and the forensic chemist!
What is this circus?! Ricardo, you had no right to summon the Notary Chief to a private home!
Actually, the Notary Chief insisted on coming the moment we showed him a $120,000 wire to his own junior clerk.

nodes.prompt: The appraiser steps back awkwardly. What do you say to him?

options.label: Politely dismiss the appraiser from the estate
options.player_reply_text: Thank you for coming, sir, but Monte Verde is not for sale—security will see you out.

options.label: Ask the appraiser to sign a witness statement
options.player_reply_text: Before you leave, please confirm for the Notary Chief that Beatriz tried to auction frozen assets!

nodes.text: Haha, that appraiser practically sprinted back to his van! Now take a seat, Aunt Beatriz.
VIP TWIST: The terrified appraiser hands over Beatriz’s signed auction order—adding unauthorized asset stripping to her file!
None of this proves the Dawn Codicil is fake! Grandmother’s signature and wax seal are right there on page four!
Then let’s place Grandmother’s REAL signet ring right next to page four.

nodes.headline: The Counterfeit Seal
nodes.teaser_text: Next Episode: Under the forensic lens, the missing third olive leaf and 30-day-old ink shatter Beatriz’s forgery live.

nodes.text: 9:20 AM · Monte Verde Dining Hall. Every eye locks onto the velvet tray as the Notary Chief raises his magnifier.
Confirmed on the record! Grandmother’s real signet ring from Vault 404 has THREE olive leaves—the wax seal on Beatriz’s codicil only has TWO!
AND the chemist just read the ink scan: the signature ink is less than THREE WEEKS old—written with the fountain pen Aunt Beatriz took from me!
No... you set me up! That junior clerk swore the registry seal was airtight—wait, stop writing that down!
Too late, Aunt. Every elder at this table just heard you confess—and the Notary Chief’s recorder is still blinking red.
Hold everything—my courthouse phone is ringing. The fraud unit just finished questioning the junior notary clerk!

nodes.prompt: Aunt Beatriz reaches for her purse to bolt out the door. What do you do?

options.label: Put Ricardo’s courthouse call on speakerphone
options.player_reply_text: Don’t leave yet, Aunt—hear what your bribed clerk just told the investigators on speaker!

options.label: Ask estate security to hold the front gate shut
options.player_reply_text: Security, close the driveway gate—officers are five minutes out and she’s not leaving with a forged deed!

nodes.text: Speaker on! Every single word from the courthouse is about to ring through this dining hall.
VIP TWIST: The heavy iron gates glide shut with a metallic clank as Beatriz collapses back into her chair!
Answer it, Ricardo! Let’s hear the official verdict!
Patching the courthouse conference line straight through to your phone now, {{player_name}}.

nodes.headline: The Clerk Breaks
nodes.teaser_text: Next Episode: The bribed clerk confesses in full—voiding the Dawn Codicil permanently and lifting the estate freeze.

nodes.text: 10:05 AM · Monte Verde Dining Hall. Sunlight streams onto the oak table as Ricardo’s conference call rings through.
Official ruling just signed: the junior clerk confessed to accepting $120,000 from Beatriz. The Dawn Codicil is VOID and the estate freeze is LIFTED!
YES!! The elders are literally clapping! And the Notary Chief just stamped the revocation right in front of Beatriz!
{{player_name}}, please... I’m your father’s sister! Tell the investigators to drop the charges—I’ll sign away every claim forever!
You forged Grandmother’s will, swapped my half-brother’s birth registry, and tried to auction off our home. Family doesn’t excuse crime.

nodes.prompt: Officers arrive at the dining hall doors. Your final word to Aunt Beatriz?

options.label: Let justice run its course without cruelty
options.player_reply_text: Go with the officers peacefully, Aunt. Face what you chose—and let this family finally heal.

options.label: Remove her from the family chat right now
options.player_reply_text: Remember when you kicked Ricardo out of the family chat? Your turn—goodbye, Aunt.

nodes.text: Dignified to the very end, {{player_name}}. Grandmother raised you well.
VIP MOMENT: SYSTEM ALERT — {{player_name}} removed Aunt Beatriz from "Monte Verde Estate" permanently!
The patrol car just cleared the front gate. Quietest morning Monte Verde has known in years.
Meet me in the conservatory at 11:40 AM, {{player_name}}—one last formal transfer to sign.

nodes.headline: Aunt’s Final Exit
nodes.teaser_text: Next Episode: Peace returns to the estate as Lucas thanks you for a second chance and the trust is restored.

nodes.text: 11:40 AM · Sunlit Conservatory. Jasmine scent drifts through open glass doors as the family gathers around the blue porcelain vase.
Every operating account is unfrozen, the art gallery is insured in perpetuity, and Grandmother’s authentic will is now legally unassailable.
Tell Grandmother I’m sorry I let jealousy blind me...
Whoa—she sent that from her lawyer’s tablet before unsending it. At least a tiny piece of her finally realized the truth.

nodes.transcript: [sincerely] Thank you for not giving up on me, {{player_name}}. I’m going to work twice as hard to earn back your trust and help run the estate.

nodes.text: You already earned it back today, Lucas. Now help me set the big table for our first peaceful family lunch.

nodes.prompt: Attorney Ricardo hands you Grandmother’s three-leaf signet ring. What do you do with it?

options.label: Wear it as guardian of the family legacy
options.player_reply_text: I’ll wear it every day—to remember that truth always outlasts greed.

options.label: Display it beside the blue vase for everyone
options.player_reply_text: Let’s place it right beside the blue porcelain vase—a shared symbol for every honest heir!

nodes.text: Fits like it was forged for you, {{player_name}}.
VIP MOMENT: Your half-brother smiles warmly and places a fresh olive branch beside the ring—uniting the bloodline at last!
Lunch is served on the sunlit terrace—and nobody is allowed to check bank apps at the table!
Coming right out!

nodes.headline: Grand Finale: The Open Table
nodes.teaser_text: Episode 20 (Grand Finale): Afternoon sunlight fills Monte Verde as the true heirs toast Grandmother’s unbroken legacy.

nodes.text: 3:30 PM · Sunlit Monte Verde Terrace. Warm breeze ripples the white linen tablecloth as laughter echoes across the garden.
Thirty years practicing estate law, and I’ve never seen a house transform from a battlefield into a home in a single afternoon.
And look—your half-brother just posted a photo of the blue porcelain vase filled with fresh sunflowers in the family chat!

nodes.transcript: [raising his glass] To Grandmother’s wisest choice—{{player_name}}, who protected the family without losing her heart.

nodes.text: Thank you, everyone. Ten minutes after her funeral, I thought this family was broken beyond repair. I’m so glad I was wrong.
Head of Monte Verde—make the first official toast for our new chapter!

nodes.prompt: Sunlight gleams on every glass. Choose your Grand Finale toast!

options.label: Toast to open doors and honest hearts
options.player_reply_text: To Grandmother’s rule: open doors for love, and locked forever against greed!

options.label: Open Grandmother’s art gallery to young artists
options.player_reply_text: And next month, we open Grandmother’s gallery wing as a free museum and scholarship for young artists!

nodes.text: Cheers!! Every single Sunday lunch at Monte Verde, no excuses!
VIP GRAND FINALE: The Monte Verde Arts Foundation launches in Grandmother’s name—turning a mansion of secrets into a beacon of light!
Legacy secured, {{player_name}}. Grandmother is smiling down on all of you today.
Welcome home, family. For good this time.

nodes.headline: Forgery Crushed. Family United Forever.
nodes.teaser_text: 20-Episode Mega-Series Complete · You exposed the forged Dawn Codicil, uncovered Grandmother’s signet ring, and united the true heirs in peace.
